info.title: LobbyStack API
info.description: Read calls, contacts, appointments and messages, book appointments, and subscribe to webhooks. Authenticate with an API key in the Authorization header. Each key allows 120 requests per minute by default.

get.description: Returns the key and its business. Any valid key can call it, whatever its scopes, so integrations use it to test a connection.

401.description: The API key is missing, invalid, or revoked (unauthorized).

bearerAuth.description: An API key from Settings > API keys. Scopes: business:read, business:write, calls:read, contacts:read, contacts:write, appointments:read, appointments:write, messages:read, knowledge:write, webhooks:manage.

Me.description: The API key making the request and the business it belongs to.

prefix.description: The visible start of the key, for example lsk_1a2b3c4d.

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/Toronto.

locale.description: Default language for callers: en or fr.

booking_mode.description: instant: appointments are booked directly. request: the receptionist takes a request and the team confirms it. off: no booking.

items.description: Opening hours for one day. Days that are not listed are closed.

hours.description: Replaces the whole week. Omit a day to close it.

items.description: Opening hours for one day. Days that are not listed are closed.

Staff.description: A person who takes appointments. A business that never set up staff has one active staff member named after the business.

active.description: Only active staff members take bookings.

service_ids.description: Active services this person can be booked for. A service with no staff assigned is open to every active staff member.

channel.description: phone: a phone call. web: a browser call from the website or dashboard.

summary.description: Short summary of the call, when one is available.

end_reason.description: Why the call ended, as reported by the call provider or receptionist.
